summary: Extraction pass over 13 stored CBI documents for items their ledgers left because they were in images, charts or pies, or because no indicator fitted. 1,205 observations added (all read from the stored documents; image labels read by eye from zoomed renders and checked against printed totals), 8 new indicators proposed. Largest blocks: the Saint Lucia CIU audited statements (2017/18, 2018/19, 2020/21, 2023/24, 2024/25), which earlier passes had left as agency accounting, and the Thailand Privilege nationality-by-package image table.

new_indicators.name: Share of a programme's estimated economic benefit by sector
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of the economic benefit of a programme (as modelled by an evaluation, e.g. gross value added) attributed to one sector or group (sector=, category= for the component), as printed. Never calculated by us.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (EY review of the Irish IIP, GVA pie chart).

new_indicators.name: Change in a programme's estimated economic benefit (percent, as printed)
new_indicators.definition: Printed percentage change in the modelled economic benefit of a programme (category= for the component, e.g. GVA) from the previous period. Never computed from levels.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (EY review of the Irish IIP, change labels on the GVA-by-year chart).

new_indicators.name: Share of programme-linked jobs in a group of sectors
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of the jobs created or modelled for a programme that fall in a stated sector or group of sectors (sector=), as printed. Counts are rbi_jobs_created.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (EY review of the Irish IIP: construction and health 69% of modelled FTE jobs).

new_indicators.name: Members paying a residence scheme's annual fee
new_indicators.definition: Members (principal accounts) of a residence or retirement-visa scheme who paid the scheme's annual membership fee in a period, as printed. Not all persons covered (dependants are included in a principal's fee).
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (Philippine Retirement Authority 2016: 8,326 members paid the Annual PRA Fee).

new_indicators.name: Share of programme agency costs by component
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of the programme costs of the agency that runs a programme in a period that went to one component (category=: due diligence, agent and promoter commissions, marketing agent commissions, travel...), as printed. Never calculated by us.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (Saint Lucia CIU 2023/24 programme-cost donut chart).

new_indicators.name: Savings on due diligence fees
new_indicators.definition: Money a programme saved on due diligence fees in a period (e.g. through volume discounts), as reported by the authority or its due diligence provider; category= for the provider; a monthly average uses period_basis monthly_average.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (Exiger section of the Saint Lucia CIU 2023/24 report: USD 330,400; USD 41,300 a month).

new_indicators.name: Change in applications processed (percent, as printed)
new_indicators.definition: Printed year-on-year percentage change in applications processed (granted plus denied). Never computed from levels.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (Saint Lucia CIU 2024/25 statistics table, % YoY column).

new_indicators.name: Change in a line of the programme agency's accounts (as printed)
new_indicators.definition: Printed change from the previous period in a line of the income statement or distributions of the agency that runs a programme (revenue, a revenue source, programme costs, operating expenses, surplus, government distribution), in percent (unit percent) or currency, and printed restatement effects on such lines. category= names the line. Never computed by us. Balance-sheet changes are in cbi_unit_financial_position.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-images-other-2026-10-10 (Saint Lucia CIU 2024/25 key financial highlights; 2018/19 prior-year adjustment).
